notes.title: Update 30/12/2024: New Area, Steam Achievement, and Performance Boost!
notes.notes:
[h1]Discover the Shadows: Update 30/12/2024
[/h1]
This update brings exciting new content and enhancements to deepen your descent into the shadows. Here’s what’s waiting for you:

[list]
[*] [b]🗺️ New Map Area:[/b] Explore an extended section of the hospital, uncovering eerie details and hidden secrets.
[*] [b]🧩 A New Puzzle:[/b] Challenge your wits with a fresh puzzle that ties directly into the unfolding story.
[*] [b]📖 Expanded Storyline:[/b] Learn more about the dark history of the hospital and the chilling events that brought it to life.
[*] [b]🚪 A Unique Room:[/b] Discover a room unlike any other in the game—mysterious, unsettling, and full of intrigue.
[*] [b]🏆 Steam Achievement:[/b] Unlock a brand-new achievement as you progress through the new content.
[*] [b]💡 Lighting Enhancements:[/b] Improved lighting for a more immersive and atmospheric experience.
[*] [b]🚀 Performance Optimization:[/b] Enjoy smoother gameplay with enhanced performance and reduced loading times.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Dive back into the shadows, uncover the mysteries, and brace yourself for what lies ahead! 🌑👻
